Full-dimensionality and uniqueness follow from John. Finite computation is corroboration only.

value.rationale: The integral odd-cycle blossom is a fundamental, irredundant matching-polytope facet. This classification proves a global qualitative dichotomy: that facet affects the maximal inscribed ellipsoid precisely for the pentagon, where it creates a strictly positive rank-one contribution and an additional facet contact, whereas for all greater odd lengths it is strictly invisible to this canonical geometric invariant. The fact is naturally motivated by comparing integral and fractional matching geometry and is not a routine isolated parameter or known-table computation.
